title: About the New Era
subtitle: Have the last wine before you leave. I saw the flames rising as the crowd cheered for the great festival and the wonderful heavens above.

trails.title: Trail ① Gossip Magazine
trails.description: A tabloid that can be seen everywhere. It describes what people in this city care about, including Mr. Forget Me Not of the Walden.

content.text:
I am so sick of him! An "arcanist" acting like the upper class! He even attended the parties in the lords' mansions. He is nothing like those who hide their identities: they know how to suck up to humans and cover up the ugly side. Look at him! A drink that turns into alcohol only when you drink it? He should be hung, and shot, and burned! Get out of our street!
—Big Mouth Bulletin: From Readers, 1927, Issue 1224-1   

He must be a weird monster! I heard a woman married a snake and bore a horrible child. That must be him! That's why he hides everything about himself. The other day I saw with my own eyes he had scales under those long sleeves, one next to another embedded in his flesh. On the fourteenth night after that, I woke up with a start from the nightmare to find a woman with a strange head staring at me from the darkness outside the window. She didn't breathe or say a word, and just put her face against the window like some dead animal ... That must be his underling ...
—Big Mouth Bulletin: From Readers, 1927, Issue 1224-1 

He gave me a hand when I needed help.
—Big Mouth Bulletin: From Readers, 1927, Issue 1224-1 

His alcohol has bewitched too many people. That green stuff can open anyone's mouth: secrets of the Anti-Saloon League, plans of the Synagogue, and even rumors of the Congress, he knew them all. There's someone different behind him. I don't know who that is, but they must be unbelievably powerful. No one's going to believe my words. I don't know why he is still alive now. That's horrible. I mean it.
—Big Mouth Bulletin: From Readers, 1927, Issue 1224-1 

Forget Me Not is the most celebrated mixologist of the early 20th century and a perfect embodiment of the American Dream. His real name is unknown to the public, and rumors about him abound. Some claim he's a wicked drug dealer, Satan reincarnate, a political spy, or even the love child of an evil serpent and a human. Although his background remains shrouded in mystery, it doesn't stop us from tasting heaven in his wonderful creations.
—Big Mouth Bulletin: From Readers, 1927, Issue 1224, Epilogue

trails.title: Trail ② Enemy at the Corner Ⅰ
trails.description: An unexpected Manus squad. You should be careful as usual.

items.text: About the New Era

items.speaker: President Michel
items.text: Oh, thank you, I've been starving for so long. Hmm ... not bad! Give me another potion.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Of course, suit yourself please.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Oh. Ms. Druvis, you're back. Have you finished potion distribution?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Yes. Patients in the stretcher zone have also taken the potion. They are feeling a bit better.

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: What's that smell? You just gave it out before we sample them?

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: The press is here in no time! You have to be fully responsible for any accident!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: The press?

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: Aren't you the ones who want a press conference? Just to show off what the arcanists do in the relief!

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: Hey! Gimme some potion! These toad freaks ...

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: He is too late.

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: Following the believer, the journalists pack into the square with cameras on their shoulders, looking around the place.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I didn't know there will be press today.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Forgive me for that I want to hold a banquet before the "Storm", Miss Druvis.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: After all, for us Manus Vindictae, this era is no longer of any value.

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: The potion ... tastes so familiar ... the smell ...

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: *spitting* This is beer?!

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: This is prohibited! Where did you get it?! I knew it, I knew we can't trust these insane people! Get them all!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Insane? No, we can't be more sane.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Forget Me Not turns to him, with a weird, excited smile on his face.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: He has waited for so long just for this moment to show his true self.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: We are neither insane, nor ever hysterical.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Not to mention practicing hypocrisy, screwing money through all the ridiculous and absurd decrees.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: The prohibition has lasted for almost 10 years, how could you know it's beer right away?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: What a hypocritical wretch!

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: Uggh ... ahh!!

items.speaker: Commissioned Corpst
items.text: As Forget Me Not raises his hands, people start to explode one after another. The rude officer falls down, with a broken stomach and guts all over the place.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What?!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: He used the potion as fuel for explosion?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Distress cometh upon those not of me. Present me thy flesh, soul and abhorring.

items.speaker: Broke Celebrity
items.text: Why!!! Arrgh!!!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: I give you death, rejoice, may the wine in Heaven be without measure.

items.speaker: President Michel
items.text: Don't ... don't kill me ... Arrgh!

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: Help! ... Run! Run!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: I will not kill you. I demand you vultures faithfully record everything that happened.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: I demand you see with your own eyes—how does an inferior take everything he has been deprived of.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Just! Like! This!

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: No! ... Help me!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Mr. Forget Me Not.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: The fall has gone. No need for more blood.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: What makes you doubt, Miss Druvis?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: "The Storm" is coming, we have accomplished our missions. And everything here should be doomed!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... The "Storm" is only the "Storm". It is not destiny.

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: *cry* Miss, please help ...

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: No! You ... you are ... I've met you!

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: You are the daughter of the late Weyerhaeuser?!

items.speaker: Journalist Ⅰ
items.text: Those Weyerhaeusers! They burned themselves after bankruptcy...

items.speaker: Journalist Ⅱ
items.text: No, not self-burned! Their daughter who studied dark magic burned them alive!

items.speaker: Journalist Ⅰ
items.text: Worth it if I take a photo of her before I die! Move! Let me take one!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Don't do this!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Flash lights, questions after questions. Nothing different.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I have not studied dark magic.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: Did your parents' death have nothing to do with you? I heard they were always against you learning dark magic.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I have not studied dark magic. I was born an arcanist.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: Which means you decided to burn them alive because of their disapproval.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I did not burn them alive. The fire was caused by gasoline. They told me ... it's twenty barrels of gasoline.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: It is not possible that 20 barrels of gasoline can cause such a fire. It is dark magic, Miss.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: It is said that you always objected to their plans of cutting the trees and selling the woods. So they did it at midnight to avoid you.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: However, you were at the scene of their death.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... I wanted to tell them

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I have just learned a new "arcane skill" ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I do hear the sound of trees. I know there is a way ... to make us all survive ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: No need to sell the woods. No need to level up trees. No need to file for bankruptcy ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: We can go back to the life we had ... the kind of life they expected.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: So you chose to escape the debt by burning down the woods.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I will find out the truth. I will find the arsonist. I will find the answer I never knew.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Druvis! Druvis ...!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I will not let the woods grow.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I will defend everything about them.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I will ... *cry*

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Enough! Don't live in the past!
Open your eyes!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Open your eyes!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Your blessing ... once brought me fortune and hope.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Now I will give this blessing to you. I will share my "tomorrow" with you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Watch your steps. Leave with me!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Vertin ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: My tomorrow ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Leave the flashlight. Get up. I'll carry you and jump out!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... Thank you.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Are you being officious, or just revealing your sting?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Forget Me Not, sooner or later, you will be destroyed by your own hatred.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: I know, but I'm sorry that you'll never live to see that day.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: He gets out his wand and a disciple appears behind him.

items.speaker: Manus Messenger
items.text: *roaring*

items.speaker: Manus Messenger
items.text: ㄐㄧㄣˇㄕㄣˊㄇㄧˋㄒㄩㄝˊㄐㄧㄚㄎㄜˇㄩㄝ

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: So, you left in such a hurry just to get your accomplice, bumblebee.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: It's time to clean the garden, my disciples!

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: *roars*
TO BE CONTINUED...
